description: data:text/css;BASE64,... (upper-case token): critical does not treat it as base64 and uses the base64 text as css, which parses to an empty sheet.

thin.note: The media type parameter base64 is case-insensitive (as in the URL standard), so the payload is decoded as base64 and the rule is included; expected-thin.css is critical's output for the same page with a lower-case ;base64.
